hero.title: Light, remembered.
hero.sub: Portrait, wedding and editorial work, made slowly.

intro: I do not chase moments. I wait for the quiet second just before them, when people forget the camera and the light settles on who they really are.

about.title: Twelve years of waiting for the right light.
about.text: My work is unposed and edited by hand. I spend time with people before the camera comes up, so what you receive feels like you. Published in Vogue Italia, Kinfolk and Harper's Bazaar.

quote.text: She disappeared into the day and somehow caught every moment that mattered.
